findings.title: `queued` timestamp is shared by every AssignmentSource instance
findings.body: `timezone.now()` is evaluated once when the class is defined, so every AssignmentSource created for the lifetime of a worker process receives the same `queued` timestamp rather than the time that assignment was queued. This makes the serialized context metadata inaccurate (and will break any age/order logic added around this carrier). Use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)` so each instance records its own creation time.
